A visual conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness that lays out sessions, follow-ups, and branches on one browsable, draggable, zoomable map. It connects cards along DSH's native fork relationships instead of inventing a second session history, syncs both ways with the native chat, and keeps DSH session logs as the single source of truth.
Install
dsh plugin --profile default add github:liangmianya/dsh-synapse
Use it when
Use it when you want a visual, non-linear map of your DSH workspace's sessions, follow-ups, and branches on a draggable, zoomable canvas, while keeping native DSH sessions as the single source of truth.
Setup example
```bash
dsh plugin --profile default add github:liangmianya/dsh-synapse
```
Then run `dsh web` (the web profile is required, Node.js >= 22.19.0) and switch to **会话地图** at the top of DSH — Synapse reuses the existing DSH web server instead of starting a second app.
